svg.title: Track
svg.desc: Oath & Action Civic Line CL-020 Track, pillar icon for 24 px on 1x screens: pixel fit B, a 1 px line drawn pixel by pixel on the 24 px grid, every feature and red placement of the master kept, the red its own shape in the accent group (DR-133). The final, approved by name on the stage B drawings board (DR-179) and promoted on November 10, 2026. On 2x screens a 24 px pillar icon draws its Civic Line master instead (DR-179). The black edition is the one in use under 48 px (D2-497); this red-black edition is kept as the record of DR-133's red placements.
